# HigherBits.dev

> HigherBits.dev is the production UI component registry and marketplace for developers, agencies, and technical virtual assistants. It offers production-ready React 19, Next.js 15, and Tailwind CSS components inspired by shadcn/ui, paired with a Multi-Format AI Prompt Engine for GoHighLevel (GHL), Cursor, Claude, Antigravity, and v0.

HigherBits eliminates generic "AI slop" by providing distinctive, polished, accessible, and performant UI components, full-page templates, themes, ASCII art, gradients, and WebGL/Three.js shaders. Copied component source has no runtime dependency on the HigherBits service; components may require React, Radix UI, motion, or other listed dependencies. Follow each item's installation instructions and applicable licenses.

## Quick Start & CLI
- [Component Installation](https://higherbits.dev/): Copy an item's source and follow its documented dependency and installation instructions. Where the item provides a registry install command, use its shadcn CLI command, following the pattern `npx shadcn@latest add "https://higherbits.dev/r/<author>/<slug>"` with the item's actual author and slug.
- [All Components Catalogue](https://higherbits.dev/?tab=home): Browse curated, copy-paste React UI blocks
- [Templates Collection](https://higherbits.dev/?tab=templates): Full-page marketing, SaaS, and funnel layouts built with shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion
- [Component Libraries Directory](https://higherbits.dev/?tab=libraries): Browse UI kits, registries, and design systems; consult the directory for its current listings
- [Full LLM Context](https://higherbits.dev/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical documentation and prompt instructions for LLM agents

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Multi-Format AI Prompt Engine**: One-click prompt copying tailored for diverse AI workflows:
  - **GoHighLevel (GHL)**: Includes an AI conversion prompt template and supported HTML/CSS/JS export paths for custom code blocks. Output and dependencies vary by path; review and test the result in the target GHL page.
  - **Claude, Cursor, Codex & Antigravity**: Structured prompts containing component logic, dependencies, and styles ready for your AI agent.
  - **v0 by Vercel, Bolt.new, Lovable, Replit, Magic Patterns & sitebrew.ai**: Specially tuned prompts for each visual builder.
- **Production-Ready Component Registry**: Copy-paste React components with no runtime dependency on the HigherBits service. Install each item's listed packages and follow its styling instructions; dependencies and their licenses still apply.
- **Creator Studio**: A comprehensive authoring suite where creators can build, preview, manage, and publish components, themes, templates, ASCII art, gradients, and WebGL/Three.js shaders.
- **Component Previews**: Preview support varies by item: supported paths use Sandpack or bundled iframe previews. Available editing and theme controls depend on the item and preview type.
- **Monetization & Bundles**: Marketplace code includes Stripe bundle checkout and Lemon Squeezy subscription checkout paths. Purchase and creator payout availability depend on configured providers, account eligibility, and the offering; check the item page and current account status.
- **Source Code & Licensing**: Copy and modify source under each item's published license, preserving required copyright and permission notices. Premium items may have separate commercial terms; review those terms before use.

## Catalogue & Discovery
- [Browse All Components](https://higherbits.dev/?tab=home): Live registry of interactive React UI components
- [Browse Templates](https://higherbits.dev/?tab=templates): Full landing pages, dashboards, and marketing funnels
- [Browse by Tag](https://higherbits.dev/s/3d): Filter components by category tags (e.g. 3d, animation, navigation, hero, buttons, cards, forms)
- [XML Sitemap](https://higherbits.dev/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of every component, tag, author, and page
